what_changed: The calibration workbook was MATERIALIZED after the protocol was frozen: candidate_draft and candidate_system_evidence were populated from the frozen candidate arms. Before this the workbook carried placeholder strings and no annotator could have judged anything from it.
why_this_does_not_compromise_the_freeze: The protocol freeze fixes the ACCEPTANCE THRESHOLDS. Materialization adds candidate content only; it does not touch the sample (row identities, KC set, arm assignment, presentation order, seed or stratification), and it happened after the thresholds were already fixed and while zero human labels and zero calibration predictions existed. It therefore cannot have influenced any threshold.
sample_unchanged_verified: All 180 rows verified field-for-field on review_case_id, unit_id, presentation_position, canonical_name, hierarchy_path, expert_reference and expert_source_citations.
blinding_reverified: Zero violations across all 180 materialized rows. Arm identity remains only in reference_human_calibration_blinded_mapping.jsonl. Native evidence ids replaced with opaque SRC_* ids. The draft self-reported grounded/partial/abstained status was deliberately dropped.
